descriptions.w3d_d29e_find_by_name_801e9e84: Finds a registered item by name: builds the name hash table at +72 on first use (32-byte object from 0x801fe1d8, 16 buckets) from the vector at +60, then looks the name up through 0x8020cbcc and returns the vector element (0x801e9db8) or null. Names are inferred.
